stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus comb-like plate rejection

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus natural dorsal-plate candidate

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus rounded-plate rejection

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus earlier rounded-plate candidate

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus stenops RealVis candidate

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus naturalized thagomizer candidate

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v100 bony-plate material hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v101 tail-spear reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v102 tail-parallel reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v93 horizontal-tail reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v94 undercount reject
stegosaurus-stenops.body: Fresh P9 candidate that reduces the flat lower spike problem, but the thagomizer reads closer to three large spikes than four. Keep out of representative selection and positive LoRA training.

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v95 tail-point reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v96 three-spike-plus-nub reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v97 lower-spike angle reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v98 horizontal tail-point reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v99 radial-count reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v90 bony-plate review hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v91 double-V review hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus previous four-spike candidate v86

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v88 leaf-plate review hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v89 stable-tail review hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v87 five-spike risk reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus alternating-plate four-spike candidate
stegosaurus-stenops.body: Previous count-level pass kept as a comparison and seed reference. It has a safer older four-spike read and useful staggered plate cue, but the new v86 candidate has stronger first-card recognition with broader plates and more separated thagomizer spikes.

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v84 four-spike review hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v85 three-spike risk reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v79 broad-plate four-spike hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v82 four-spike review hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v83 lower-overlap review hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v77 broad-plate review hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v73 clean-plate source hold

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v75 tail-overcount reject

stegosaurus-stenops.title: Stegosaurus v76 leaf-plate overcount reject

velociraptor-mongoliensis.title: Velociraptor P9 v64-v66 crop audit

velociraptor-mongoliensis.title: Velociraptor P6 v51-v56 crop audit
velociraptor-mongoliensis.body: Close crop gate for v9, v56, v54, v55, v53, v51, v52, v50, and the guides across full body, toothed snout, folded forelimb, both feet, near sickle toe, and far foot. It records v56 as the best current balance but not a final anatomy approval.
